issue_context.title: (Possible) missing downsampling test with flattened field dimension
issue_context.body:
### Elasticsearch Version

8.7.0 and above

### Installed Plugins

_No response_

### Java Version

_bundled_

### OS Version

All

### Problem Description

Make sure we have a test running downsampling on a TSDB index that defines dimensions including at least a flattened field.
Note that using a flattened field as dimension requires dimension fields to be explicitly defined by means of an array `time_series_dimensions: [dim_1, dim_2,...]` where each dimension path is taken from the root of the flattened field.

### Steps to Reproduce

Try to downsample a TSDB index that uses a flattened field as dimension.

### Logs (if relevant)

_No response_

review_comments: Can you come up with a scenario when flattened field can be a multi-field? Cause right now this does not support that.

I can't think of a scenario. A flattened field isn't a leaf field, but an object field that gets indexed as if it is a leaf field. So you can indexing it into a single numeric and keyword field via multi fields isn't possible.
